Game Overview

In Cubic Rush, the core idea is straightforward: experience the thrill in Cubic Rush, where rhythm meets precision. Guide a dynamic red cube along a slick path, jumping over obstacles with perfect timing. Each leap scores points and unleashes pop effects, but one misstep ends it all. Can you keep the momentum going?
